questions.question: How long are customer invoices kept after the contract ends?
questions.reference: Customer invoices and account records are kept for six years after the contract ends.

questions.question: How long are recruitment records for unsuccessful applicants kept?
questions.reference: Recruitment records for unsuccessful applicants are kept for 12 months.

questions.question: How long are server access logs kept?
questions.reference: Server access logs are kept for 180 days.

questions.question: How quickly is a suspected breach escalated to the Data Protection Lead after discovery?
questions.reference: A suspected personal data breach is escalated to the Data Protection Lead within 4 hours of discovery.

questions.question: Who decides whether to notify the supervisory authority under the breach procedure?
questions.reference: The Data Protection Lead decides whether to notify the supervisory authority.

questions.question: How soon are data subject access requests acknowledged and answered?
questions.reference: Data subject access requests are acknowledged within 5 working days and answered within one month.

questions.question: How is identity verified before records are released?
questions.reference: Identity is verified with two pieces of information already held on the account before records are released.

questions.question: When may customer information be transferred outside the EEA?
questions.reference: Customer personal data is not transferred outside the EEA unless the transfer tool is standard contractual clauses or an adequacy decision recorded in the transfer register.

questions.question: When is marketing email to prospects allowed?
questions.reference: Marketing email to prospects is sent only with prior consent.

questions.question: Do non-essential cookies stay off until the user opts in?
questions.reference: Non-essential cookies stay off until the user opts in.

questions.question: When is a processor engaged, and when is the security review marked pass?
questions.reference: A processor is not engaged until a written Article 28 contract is signed and the security review is marked pass in the vendor register.

questions.question: Does Helios sell customer information to data brokers?
questions.reference: Helios does not sell customer personal data to data brokers.

questions.question: May staff paste customer information into a public AI chatbot?
questions.reference: Staff must not paste customer personal data into a public AI chatbot.

questions.question: Which tool is approved for internal drafting and which vendor register entry covers it?
questions.reference: The approved tool for internal drafting is Helios Draft, which is hosted in the EEA and covered by vendor register entry VD-014.

questions.question: How are production databases encrypted, and what does access require?
questions.reference: Production databases are encrypted at rest with AES-256 and access requires SSO plus a hardware key.

questions.question: When is a DPIA required before a credit feature launches?
questions.reference: A DPIA is required before launching a feature that scores the creditworthiness of a sole trader.

questions.question: In the customer DPA, when does Helios act as processor and when as controller?
questions.reference: Helios acts as processor for bookkeeping records the customer uploads, and as controller for its own account, billing, and security logs.

questions.question: What legal basis does purpose P-12 record for hosting customer ledgers?
questions.reference: Purpose P-12 is hosting customer ledgers with legal basis Article 6(1)(b) contract.

questions.question: Where do customer exports stay, and may staff store them on personal laptops?
questions.reference: Exports stay in the approved vault. Staff must not store customer exports on personal laptops.

questions.question: Where does a whistleblowing report go when it concerns the Data Protection Lead?
questions.reference: A whistleblowing report that concerns the Data Protection Lead goes to the independent board member named in this clause.

questions.question: When must staff complete training after joining, and when is the calendar year refresher due?
questions.reference: All staff complete data protection training within 14 days of joining and a refresher each calendar year.

questions.question: What does the indexed GDPR Article 5 accountability excerpt say the controller must be able to demonstrate?
questions.reference: The controller shall be responsible for, and be able to demonstrate compliance with, paragraph 1 ('accountability').

questions.question: What does point (a) of the indexed GDPR Article 6 excerpt say about consent?
questions.reference: Point (a) says the data subject has given consent to the processing of his or her personal data for one or more specific purposes.

questions.question: What time limit does the indexed GDPR Article 33 excerpt state for notifying the supervisory authority?
questions.reference: The controller notifies the supervisory authority not later than 72 hours after having become aware of the breach, where feasible.

questions.question: What access right does the indexed GDPR Article 15 excerpt describe?
questions.reference: The data subject has the right to obtain from the controller confirmation as to whether or not personal data concerning him or her are being processed, and access to that data.
